svg.title: dsh-drill-script-check — rule x field matrix
svg.desc: Eight rules (DR-001 to DR-008) as columns and eleven material fields as rows; a dot marks a field a rule reads, a ring the trigger field of DR-004, sigma and equals the row sum DR-005 compares with the header total. Material and rule pack converge on drill_script_check above the matrix; issues, skipped and summary are the report exits below it.
svg.text: Each rule reads only the fields it declares
drill_script_check · material JSON / YAML (rows[] + header) × rules/*.yaml (8 rules, 2026.1)
evidence kind caps severity — direct → any · derived-from-principle ≤ warn (7) · institutional-configuration ≤ info (DR-003); no verbatim excerpt in this pack
found: phase — · script — → fix: fill either
a finding is one cell — row × field — and the matrix shows reads, not verdicts
